approach: Static recompilation of the game's PowerPC 603e code to C++ (in-repo ppcrecomp), hybrid core with instruction-exact interpreter fallback, Model 3 hardware from Supermodel
notes: v0.1.0 released for Linux and Windows, but the prebuilt packages are compiled with recompilation OFF: they contain no game code and run the CPU on Supermodel's interpreter. The recompiled build is generated at build time from your own ROM set and must not be redistributed. No game code is included in the repo or releases.
